name: Quyt duong
summary: Quýt đường, the sugar mandarin grown beside the cam sành at Quảng Phú and given the same 4-star provincial OCOP rating. You taste it in the same garden.
origin: The Dak Nong tourism portal’s OCOP article.
howToEat: The portal names quýt đường with cam sành as a 4-star provincial OCOP product and says guests taste the fruit in the garden.
seoDescription: Quýt đường from Quảng Phú in Krong No, named with cam sành as a 4-star provincial OCOP fruit.
